Usage: agentcage cage audit [OPTIONS] NAME

  Query, filter, and summarize proxy audit logs.

Options:
  -d, --decision [blocked|flagged|allowed]
                                  Filter by decision (repeatable).
  --host TEXT                     Filter by target host (substring match,
                                  repeatable).
  --inspector TEXT                Filter by inspector name (repeatable).
  --severity [debug|info|warning|error|critical]
                                  Minimum inspector severity.
  --direction [inbound|outbound]  Filter by traffic direction (repeatable).
  --method TEXT                   Filter by HTTP method (repeatable).
  --since TEXT                    Time window: 1h, 30m, 7d, or ISO date.
  -n, --max-entries INTEGER       Max entries to show (0 = unlimited).
                                  [default: 100]
  -f, --follow                    Stream new entries in real time.
  --json                          Output as JSON lines.
  --summary                       Show aggregated statistics.
  --no-color                      Disable colored output.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
